# LeakSanitizer suppressions for ci.yml's asan job (LSAN_OPTIONS=suppressions=...).
#
# Intentionally empty. An entry must name an internal function of a third-party
# component that makes a one-time allocation (process-lifetime cache, static
# initialization), with a comment saying why. Never name a library
# (leak:libGLESv2) or an exported EGL/GL/Vulkan entry point (leak:eglInitialize):
# either hides every unreachable allocation made under it, including ones our
# own misuse causes. The published ANGLE libraries are stripped, so naming an
# ANGLE-internal function first needs the unstripped-libraries follow-up
# described in openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-27-ci-pipeline/design.md.
